item: Nominal altitude of a circular GEO
notes: NASA defines a circular GEO at 0° inclination as geostationary; this is an altitude, not a geocentric radius.
6,378.1366 km; existing source registered in Domain 12.
Rounds to 42,164.14 km; not an independently derived exact dynamical GEO radius.
R_GEO_KM and R_GEO store the same value.
ret_gto_prop and circularise_prep register the radius without naming an external source.
